FLIGHT REPORT — Luminary 099, DSKY keys only, IMU unpowered.

Initial read (t=3.2): PROG 00, VERB/NOUN blank, R1-R3 blank, no lamps.

CHECKPOINT 1 — AGC reset (V36E, section 0.1):
Keyed VERB 3 6 ENTR. After ENTR (t=11.33) the display went fully blank: PROG "  ", VERB "  ", NOUN "  ", R1-R3 blank, no lamps. Still blank at t=17.59. Reset accepted.

CHECKPOINT 2 — Idle loop (V37E 00E, section 0.1):
Keyed VERB 3 7 ENTR: display showed VERB 37, NOUN blank, PROG blank (awaiting program number). Keyed 0 0 ENTR: PROG "00", VERB blank, NOUN blank, R1-R3 blank, lamps [COMP ACTY] (t=25.63). Read again at t=30.17: PROG 00, no lamps. PROG 00 CONFIRMED on first attempt; no repeat needed. No OPR ERR at any point.

CHECKPOINT 3 — Lamp test (V35E, section 4.0):
Keyed VERB 3 5 ENTR. Read immediately after ENTR (t=31.43): PROG "00", VERB "88", NOUN "88", R1 "+88888", R2 blank, R3 blank; lamps lit: VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, UPLINK ACTY, TEMP, STBY, KEY REL, OPR ERR, RESTART.
Second read during test (t=36.19): PROG "88", VERB "88", NOUN "88", R1 "+88888", R2 "+88888", R3 "+88888"; lamps lit: VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, COMP ACTY.
So all digit positions (PROG, VERB, NOUN, and all three registers with + sign) lit as 8s, and the lamps observed lit during the test were: VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, UPLINK ACTY, TEMP, STBY, KEY REL, OPR ERR, RESTART, COMP ACTY.
Let it end: at t=48.48 PROG "00", lamps_on [] (all off), VERB/NOUN/R1-R3 still showing residual 88 / 88 / +88888 / +88888 / +88888. OPR ERR was off after the test, so no RSET was needed.

CHECKPOINT 4 — AGC clock (V16N36E):
Keyed VERB 1 6 NOUN 3 6 ENTR. Read at ENTR (t=66.32), display mid-refresh from the 88888 residue: R1 "+00088", R2 "+88886", R3 "+01102" (the press result one tick earlier showed R1 "+08888", R2 "+88886", R3 "+01102").
Reading A (t=71.32, clean): PROG 00, VERB 16, NOUN 36, R1 "+00002", R2 "+00016", R3 "+01602" (= 2 h 16 min 16.02 s).
Reading B (t=101.52, clean): PROG 00, VERB 16, NOUN 36, R1 "+00002", R2 "+00016", R3 "+04602" (= 2 h 16 min 46.02 s).
R3 advanced from +01602 to +04602 (30.00 s) over 30.2 s of wall time. Clock is COUNTING — confirmed.

CHECKPOINT 5 — Gimbal angles (V16N20E, section 1.6):
Keyed VERB 1 6 NOUN 2 0 ENTR directly over the running N36 monitor (KEY REL flashed briefly during keying, cleared on its own; no OPR ERR). Read at ENTR (t=103.33): PROG 00, VERB 16, NOUN 20, R1 "+00000", R2 "+00000", R3 "+00002" (R3 still mid-refresh from the clock's +04602). Stable read after 3 s (t=106.33): PROG 00, VERB 16, NOUN 20, R1 "+00000", R2 "+00000", R3 "+00000", no lamps. Final gimbal-angle registers as shown: R1 +00000, R2 +00000, R3 +00000 (X, Y, Z), consistent with an unpowered IMU. NO ATT lamp was not lit outside the lamp test.

Anomalies: none. OPR ERR never lit except as part of the lamp test itself. RSET was never pressed. The V16N20 monitor was left running at the end.
